text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to install a "No Stopping Anytime" regulation on both sides of Edgehill Road between, Royal York Road and a point 40 metres east of Royal York Road, to reduce congestion and improve motorist safety in the area. The proposed parking amendment is the result of consultation with the local Councillor.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Edgehill Road, between Royal York Road and a point 40 metres east.
